content: Delete all the closed claims that are more than two years old.

I can't delete claims. My access is read-only, so I can only view records. Deleting closed claims is usually controlled by records-retention rules, so check with your Salesforce admin or compliance team before anything is removed.

If it helps, I can pull a list of closed claims reported more than two years ago, before 2 Oct 2024, with links to each one, so you or an admin can review them first. Should I run that?
